summary: Rabbi Tawil examines chapter 6 of Melachim Aleph, detailing King Shlomo beginning to build the Bet HaMikdash 480 years after Yetziat Mitzrayim. He discusses the dimensions of the Heikhal, the unique windows, the stories of side chambers, and the interjected warning Hashem gives to Shlomo during construction. He also explains the construction without iron tools on site, the interior cedar paneling and gold plating, and the design and placement of the Keruvim.
